note: Question copy, options and coaching tips for the onboarding flow. Coaching tips follow PRD Appendix A: directional statements, never statistical claims, never urgency.

welcome.headline: Find the right way to advertise your business
welcome.sub: Answer a few questions and we'll recommend the best channels, formats, and budget for your goals. Takes about 3 minutes.
welcome.credibility: Your ad can run across Alma's titles — Iltalehti, Kauppalehti and Etuovi.

urlStep.question: What's your website address?
urlStep.helper: We'll take a quick look at your website to better understand your business. This helps us give you a more relevant recommendation.
urlStep.tip: The more context we have about your business, the sharper the recommendation. Sharing your website is the fastest way to get there.

goalStep.question: What do you want to achieve?
goalStep.tip: The clearest goal gets the sharpest result. Advertisers who focus on one objective at a time consistently outperform those trying to do everything at once.

options.label: Drive more people to my website
options.hint: Reach people who are ready to browse and buy

options.label: Increase awareness of my business
options.hint: Build recognition so people think of you first

options.label: Promote an event or offer
options.hint: Reach a large audience quickly with a time-limited message

options.label: Grow my local customer base
options.hint: Reach people in your area who are looking for what you offer

options.label: Drive online sales
options.hint: Convert browsers into buyers with targeted reach

timelineStep.question: When do you want to run your advertising?
timelineStep.tip: Consistency beats intensity. A steady presence over several weeks builds brand recognition far more effectively than a single short burst.

startOptions.label: As soon as possible
startOptions.hint: We'll get you moving right away

startOptions.label: I have a specific start date
startOptions.hint: Pick the day it should begin

durationOptions.label: 2 weeks
durationOptions.hint: Good for events, launches, or quick tests

durationOptions.label: 1 month
durationOptions.hint: A solid run to build visibility

durationOptions.label: I'll decide later
durationOptions.hint: We'll recommend based on your goal

audienceStep.question: Who are you trying to reach?
audienceStep.typeQuestion: What kind of people are they?
audienceStep.tip: Tighter focus, better results. For local businesses, reaching the right people in the right area is worth far more than reaching everyone.

geographyOptions.label: Finland-wide
geographyOptions.hint: Anyone in the country could be a customer

geographyOptions.label: A specific city
geographyOptions.hint: Best for a single location or storefront

budgetStep.question: What's your advertising budget?
budgetStep.tip: A moderate budget run over time consistently outperforms the same budget spent in a short burst. Frequency builds recognition — and recognition builds trust.
budgetStep.reassurance: You won't be charged here. This is just to build your recommendation.
budgetStep.allTiersNote: We'll show you what this budget can realistically achieve before you commit to anything.

tiers.name: Getting started
tiers.label: Small
tiers.hint: Good for focused local reach and testing what works

tiers.name: Building presence
tiers.label: Medium
tiers.hint: Recommended for consistent visibility across one or two channels

tiers.name: I have a specific budget
tiers.label: Custom
tiers.hint: Tell us your number and we'll build the best plan around it

recommendationStep.tip: A visible logo and one clear call-to-action are the two things that make display ads work. This is also a requirement for Performance Display — so you're already on the right track.
recommendationStep.reachDisclaimer: Actual results will vary based on final targeting and creative.
